description:
Gold prices on a date

The intrinsic value of gram gold (24, 22, 18 and 14 karat), the troy ounce and the Turkish coins (çeyrek, yarım, tam, ikibuçuk, beşli, Cumhuriyet, Ata beşli) on `date` (default: the latest price), from the price of 1 g of fine gold calculated by Narodowy Bank Polski each Polish business day. USD and EUR use NBP's mid rates of that day; TRY goes through USD at TCMB's forex midpoint of the latest bulletin on or before that day (`meta.rates`). These are melt values, without workmanship or a dealer's spread. Use for gram gold, ounce or Turkish gold coin (çeyrek, yarım, tam, Cumhuriyet) values in TRY, USD or EUR. They are intrinsic values, not a jeweller's buying/selling price.

GET /v1/gold/prices on Gold & commodities (SBX-GOLD). Costs 1 credit per call.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, since 2013-01-02. A day without a price answers the latest one before it (`meta.date`).
